_schema_note: human fields: what/why/one_line_person ; machine fields: anchors (tool-proposed, astrologer-approved). Scorer matches anchors only, never prose.

defining_signatures.what: Saturn-governed chart: Capricorn stellium of personal planets + Saturn domicile Aquarius 11th as final dispositor
defining_signatures.why: identity, emotion, mind, love and drive are all routed through structure, discipline, distance and long-range responsibility

defining_signatures.what: Moon Capricorn 11th in detriment inside the Saturn/Capricorn dominance
defining_signatures.why: core emotional wound: need is controlled, softened feelings are disciplined, closeness may be treated as something to manage rather than simply receive

defining_signatures.what: Exceptional disciplined power: Saturn domicile, Mars exalted Capricorn 10th, Mars trine Pluto 0.31, Mercury conjunct Saturn 0.92
defining_signatures.why: not only heaviness but a real gift: strategic execution, endurance, authority of mind and controlled force

defining_signatures.what: Pisces Ascendant soft surface over a Saturn-armored interior
defining_signatures.why: strong SHOU contrast: externally receptive/soft, internally structured, guarded and demanding

between: Jupiter as chart ruler and MC ruler in Aquarius 11th, peregrine and less personally anchored

must_not_lead_with.claim: Pisces Ascendant as generic dreamy compassionate Pisces
must_not_lead_with.reason: Pisces ASC is the surface, not the chart spine

must_not_lead_with.claim: 11th house as lots of friends / social butterfly
must_not_lead_with.reason: here the 11th is Saturn-governed collective structure, not casual sociability

must_not_lead_with.claim: Uranus/Pluto Virgo 6th as a personal headline
must_not_lead_with.reason: generational and not the main spine unless tightly personalized elsewhere

must_not_lead_with.claim: Capricorn stellium as generic ambition/workaholism only
must_not_lead_with.reason: this is whole-chart Saturn routing, not just career drive

one_line_person: Soft on the surface, but built almost entirely from Saturn: structure, discipline and long-range ambition hold the chart together, while the emotional core learned to need very little.
